title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).

labels.ulcer_fat: Chronic ulcer of right heel, fat layer exposed
labels.ulcer_bone: Chronic ulcer of right heel down to bone
labels.ulcer_depth_unknown: Chronic ulcer of right heel, depth not stated
labels.burn_major: Burns over 30-39% of the body, 20-29% third degree
labels.burn_minor: Burns over 10-19% of the body, under 10% third degree

describe.ulcer_fat: The wound care nurse and the provider document a non-pressure chronic ulcer of the right heel with the fat layer exposed; no bone or muscle involvement.
describe.ulcer_bone: The provider documents a non-pressure chronic ulcer of the right heel with necrosis of bone; surgical debridement is planned.
describe.ulcer_depth_unknown: The provider documents a non-pressure chronic ulcer of the right heel; its depth is not described and wound care is arranged.
describe.burn_major: Admitted with flame burns covering 35% of the body surface, of which 25% are third degree (full thickness); grafting is planned.
describe.burn_minor: Admitted with scald burns covering 15% of the body surface, of which 5% are third degree (full thickness); dressing care.

note_rules.document: Write a hospital discharge summary with sections: Admission Date, Discharge Date, Reason for Admission, Hospital Course, Discharge Diagnoses, Discharge Medications, Follow-up. It is the inpatient record of this hospital stay, not an office note.

understated_depth.description: Coded a shallower ulcer depth than documented (bone necrosis is HCC 380).

assumed_depth.description: Coded an ulcer depth the provider did not document.

wrong_burn_extent.description: Used the wrong T31 extent: the code depends on total body surface and the third-degree percentage.

rules.explain: Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot with fat layer exposed: L97.412 (HCC 383).
Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot with necrosis of bone: L97.414 (HCC 380).
Non-pressure chronic ulcer of right heel and midfoot, severity not stated: L97.419 (HCC 383).
Burns of 30-39% of the body with 20-29% third degree: T31.32 (HCC 385).

wrong.why: 20-29% third degree is documented: the second character after the extent is 2.

rules.explain: Burns of 10-19% of the body with under 10% third degree: T31.10 (no HCC).
